data.name: 2 protesters arrested outside Dallas RNC rally, including 1 for assault
data.notes: Dallas Police-attributed event outcome. Arrest/accusation state only; article says names and specific charges would be released after booking and the investigation was ongoing.

sources.title: 2 protesters arrested outside Dallas RNC rally, including 1 for assault

summary: NBC 5 reports Dallas Police said two protesters were arrested near McKinnon and Payne streets on September 10: one was accused of assaulting a counter-protester and one of obstructing a road; police said the assault victim did not require medical treatment and the investigation remained ongoing.
title: NBC 5 DFW — Dallas RNC protest arrests
